settings.headline: Nominate
settings.subtitle: Seen work that deserves a bigger room? Tell us. Nominations are free and the nominee never pays an entry fee.

settings.headline: Who should the jury see?
settings.intro: We will contact the nominee before anything happens. Your name is only shared with them if you say so.
settings.aside:
• Explain why the work matters, not just that you like it.
  • Add a link if the work is online.
  • You can nominate yourself. Many winners did.

steps.title: We read every nomination
steps.text: The team checks that the work fits the rules.

steps.title: We contact the nominee
steps.text: Nothing is entered or published without their permission.

steps.title: The jury decides
steps.text: Nominated work is judged exactly like every other entry.
